_doc: A G3 size exception is {"max_lines": N, "why": "..."}; the module may not exceed N lines. Ratchet file (docs/RULES.md section G, C2). Each count is today's value of one bad pattern, measured by tests/scan.py. CI fails if a count GROWS, and also if it SHRINKS without this file being lowered (so it can never grow back). Keep every non-zero count in docs/bottlenecks.csv.
